This is another one of those look-and-feel choices, so I'll just give you my preference. Both end up with the same tag on the bookmark, so either is fine by me.

If I'm choosing: I like the inline field from before better. Typing the tag right there on the bookmark and hitting Enter feels quicker and lighter, especially since I'll probably be tagging a lot. Popping open a separate dialog box each time feels like a bit more ceremony than adding a tag needs.

So my pick is the inline version. Not a strong feeling though — let's move on to the real functionality.
